facts.title: summer ricotta with grilled vegetables
ingredients: 3 tablespoons (45 grams) freshly squeezed lemon juice
1 pound (455 grams) mixed summer vegetables, thinly sliced
8 slices from a large sourdough loaf
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
facts.yield_text: Make 1 cup ricotta; Serves 4, as shown
facts.author: Deb Perelman
